purpose: Configurable recommendations for LocalAI/NexusAI forensic evidence models and backends. Runtime code should read installed model IDs and operator configuration instead of hardcoding these choices.

principles: Prefer deterministic parsers and databases for exact facts, counts, joins, filters, timestamps, identities, and provenance.
Use LLMs and multimodal models for extraction, interpretation, routing, summarization, OCR correction, and analyst productivity only after provenance-bearing artifacts exist.
Start with smaller local models for smoke testing, then benchmark larger models against the same evidence fixtures before changing production defaults.
Never download large weights without explicit operator approval.

profiles.cpu: Small quantized models and deterministic adapters for machines without GPU acceleration.
profiles.balanced: Default local development profile: good quality without assuming a large GPU.
profiles.accuracy: Prefer larger models or specialist models when latency and disk usage are acceptable.
profiles.throughput: Prefer faster ASR/OCR/embedding paths for bulk processing.
profiles.multilingual: Prefer models with broad language and accent coverage.

recommended_models.name: qwen_qwen3-4b-instruct-2507
recommended_models.role: analyst synthesis and query planning, not exact analytics
recommended_models.notes: Use only to explain deterministic query results and ask clarifying questions.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-30b-a3b
recommended_models.role: higher-quality analyst synthesis on GPU or high-memory machines
recommended_models.notes: Use after benchmarking against the small profile; keep deterministic SQL as source of truth.

recommended_models.name: BAAI/bge-m3
recommended_models.role: multilingual long-context embedding and hybrid retrieval baseline
recommended_models.notes: Good default for evidence retrieval and route classification; pair with exact stores for counts.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-embedding-0.6b
recommended_models.role: small multilingual embedding candidate
recommended_models.notes: Use for low-resource local testing when BGE-M3 or larger Qwen3 embedding models are too heavy.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-reranker-0.6b
recommended_models.role: rerank Knowledge Base results before final answer synthesis
recommended_models.notes: Use to reduce hallucination risk by promoting better source chunks.

documents_ocr.label: Documents and OCR

recommended_models.name: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6
recommended_models.role: OCR for multilingual printed text and messy scans
recommended_models.notes: Use through a document/OCR adapter rather than a chat model.

recommended_models.name: Docling VLM pipeline
recommended_models.role: document layout, tables, figures, formulas, and export to structured text
recommended_models.notes: Use Docling models such as Granite-Docling or SmolDocling where supported.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-vl-8b-instruct
recommended_models.role: visual document understanding and analyst explanation after OCR/layout extraction
recommended_models.notes: Do not use this as the only source of truth for tables; store OCR/table extraction first.

benchmark_tasks: OCR character error rate on scanned forms

recommended_models.name: whisper-large-turbo
recommended_models.role: fast multilingual transcription baseline
recommended_models.notes: Good first local model for broad language coverage and speed.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-asr-0.6b
recommended_models.role: efficient multilingual ASR candidate
recommended_models.notes: Benchmark against Whisper on local accents and noisy call recordings.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-asr-1.7b
recommended_models.role: higher-accuracy multilingual ASR candidate
recommended_models.notes: Use when local hardware can support the larger model.

recommended_models.name: parakeet-cpp-ctc-0.6b
recommended_models.role: high-throughput speech recognition candidate
recommended_models.notes: Use for speed tests and streaming workflows.

audio_events_voice.label: Audio events and voice metadata

recommended_models.name: ced
recommended_models.role: audio event detection
recommended_models.notes: Use to tag non-speech evidence signals; keep events linked to timestamps.

recommended_models.name: voice-detect
recommended_models.role: voice activity or voice metadata adapter
recommended_models.notes: Use only with clear provenance and confidence thresholds.

benchmark_tasks: false positive rate on background noise

recommended_models.name: qwen3-vl-8b-instruct
recommended_models.role: visual question answering and image description
recommended_models.notes: Use for analyst-friendly visual summaries; exact detections should come from specialist adapters.

recommended_models.name: qwen3-vl-2b-instruct
recommended_models.role: small vision-language smoke test model
recommended_models.notes: Use first on constrained local hardware.

recommended_models.name: rfdetr-cpp
recommended_models.role: object detection adapter
recommended_models.notes: Store bounding boxes, labels, confidences, and image coordinates.

recommended_models.name: insightface
recommended_models.role: face embedding or recognition adapter when policy allows
recommended_models.notes: Use only with explicit legal/policy controls and audit thresholds.

video.label: Video evidence

recommended_models.name: qwen3-vl-8b-instruct
recommended_models.role: sampled-frame and short-clip visual understanding
recommended_models.notes: Use alongside deterministic frame sampling and event timestamps.

recommended_models.name: sam3-cpp
recommended_models.role: segmentation/tracking candidate
recommended_models.notes: Use for object masks when frame-level detections need richer geometry.

recommended_models.name: whisper-large-turbo
recommended_models.role: extract transcript from video audio track
recommended_models.notes: Store transcript chunks with start/end timestamps tied to the video evidence ID.

benchmark_tasks: analyst query latency over long videos

recommended_models.name: qwen_qwen3-4b-instruct-2507
recommended_models.role: classification explanation and analyst triage after deterministic sniffing
recommended_models.notes: Never let the model override hash, MIME, parser, or route facts; it explains uncertainty.
